title: The KRAB Domain of ZNF10 Guides the Identification of Specific Amino Acids That Transform the Ancestral KRAB-A-Related Domain Present in Human PRDM9 into a Canonical Modern KRAB-A Domain.
authors: Lorenz, Peter; Steinbeck, Felix; Krause, Ludwig; Thiesen, Hans-Jurgen
one_liner_zh: 该文研究ZNF10 KRAB结构域及PRDM9祖先KRAB-A向现代KRAB-A的功能转化，涉及蛋白-蛋白互作与AlphaFold2结构建模，但核心对象非TF-DNA结合，方法可迁移性有限。
abstract: Kruppel-associated box (KRAB) zinc finger proteins are a large class of tetrapod transcription factors that usually exert transcriptional repression through recruitment of TRIM28/KAP1. The evolutionary root of modern KRAB domains (mKRAB) can be traced back to an ancestral motif (aKRAB) that occurs even in invertebrates. Here, we first stratified three subgroups of aKRAB sequences from the animal kingdom (PRDM9, SSX and coelacanth KZNF families) and defined ancestral subdomains for KRAB-A and KRAB-B. Using human ZNF10 mKRAB-AB as blueprints for function, we then identified the necessary amino acid changes that transform the inactive aKRAB-A of human PRDM9 into an mKRAB domain capable of mediating silencing and complexing TRIM28/KAP1 in human cells when employed as a hybrid with ZNF10-B. Full gain of function required replacement of residues KR by the conserved motif MLE (positionsA32-A34), which inserted an additional residue, and exchange of A9/S for F, A20/M for L, and A27/R for V. AlphaFold2 modelling documented an evolutionary conserved L-shaped body of two alpha-helices in all KRAB domains. It is transformed into a characteristic spatial arrangement typical for mKRAB-AB upon the amino acid replacements and in conjunction with a third helix supplied by mKRAB-B. Side-chains pointing outward from the core KRAB 3D structure may reveal a protein-protein interaction code enabling graded binding of TRIM28 to different KRAB domains. Our data provide basic insights into structure-function relationships and emulate transitions of KRAB during evolution.
abstract_zh: Kruppel相关盒（KRAB）锌指蛋白是一类庞大的四足动物转录因子，通常通过招募TRIM28/KAP1来发挥转录抑制作用。现代KRAB结构域（mKRAB）的进化根源可追溯至一个祖先基序（aKRAB），该基序甚至存在于无脊椎动物中。在此，我们首先从动物界中划分出aKRAB序列的三个亚组（PRDM9、SSX和腔棘鱼KZNF家族），并定义了KRAB-A和KRAB-B的祖先亚结构域。以人ZNF10 mKRAB-AB作为功能蓝图，我们随后鉴定了将人PRDM9的无活性aKRAB-A转化为能够介导沉默并与TRIM28/KAP1形成复合物的mKRAB结构域所需的必要氨基酸变化，该结构域在与ZNF10-B杂交使用时可在人细胞中发挥作用。功能的完全获得需要将残基KR替换为保守基序MLE（位置A32-A34），这插入了一个额外残基，并将A9/S交换为F、A20/M交换为L、A27/R交换为V。AlphaFold2建模记录了所有KRAB结构域中进化保守的L形双α螺旋体。在氨基酸替换后，该结构转变为mKRAB-AB典型的特征性空间排列，并与mKRAB-B提供的第三个螺旋协同作用。从核心KRAB三维结构向外突出的侧链可能揭示一种蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用密码，使TRIM28能够分级结合不同的KRAB结构域。我们的数据为结构-功能关系提供了基础见解，并模拟了KRAB在进化过程中的转变。
